description: A short label shown above child (DESIGN.md, Tooltip): on a mouse or a pen, after TsuyaDuration.tooltipDelay; on keyboard focus, at once; never on touch. Stays open while the pointer is over the bubble itself, with a TsuyaDuration.fast grace after leaving either; Escape or a press on child hides it. With describe, message is attached as child's semantics `tooltip` (set describe to false when child already carries one of its own, as `Pressable(tooltip:)` does for an icon button repeating its own label). side can be any of the four, AnchorSide.start and AnchorSide.end following the text direction; while not enabled it never shows (and goes if it was), with child kept in the same place in the tree.

constructors.description: Shows message above child (or on side, flipped when it does not fit).

params.name: describe
params.description: Attaches message as child's `tooltip` semantics. Default true; false when child already carries it.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Whether it shows at all. Default true.
